title: Reference triangle
text: The relationship $$\sin(\theta)=x=\frac{x}{1}$$ can be encoded in a right triangle with opposite side length $$x$$ and hypotenuse $$1$$. \n The image below shows a right triangle with an unlabeled horizontal base. The vertical opposite side is labeled $$x$$, and a diagonal hypotenuse is labeled $$1$$. The acute angle between the base and the hypotenuse is labeled theta.\n##figure1.gif##

title: Find adjacent side length
text: By the Pythagorean theorem, the adjacent side length is $$\sqrt{1-x**2}$$
